source.topologySemantics: NWB junction topology is used only for mobility and explicitly assumed road logistics/supply; it is never power, gas, water, drainage, telecom or facility topology. A/N routes and international/numeric co-designations sharing one unambiguous wegnummer are one physical corridor, not additive capacity. A source section may support consecutive series edges at a municipal junction; those edge ceilings are not parallel capacity and must never be summed as independent corridors.
